name: mass_without_material_is_unknown
why: THE CASE THIS OPERATION EXISTS FOR. Without a material SOLIDWORKS does not fail: it answers with the default density of the model, which is 1000 kg/m3 -- water. On the same 200,000 mm3 cube that is 0.2 kg instead of 1.6: a believable number, wrong by EIGHT TIMES, and the place where it is found out is the quote. Measured on 15/9/2026.
_why_null_and_not_zero: the mass is `null`, not zero: zero would be a part that weighs nothing, and it would be an answer. `null` means «unknown», and it comes with a sentence saying what to do. The volume, instead, is perfectly well known, and in fact it is there.

expect.tolerance_why: the volume is read in cubic metres and multiplied by a billion

expect.why: the refusal must say WHAT is not known, WHY the answer from SOLIDWORKS would be believable, and WHAT to do
